description: Appearance examples; training coordinates used only to build patches, never at detection time.
negative_sources: Non-target proposals from the seven training frames, plus the five older development frames (1,2,3,4-20,5).
validation_note: The other 14 pic frames were not used as templates, but the entire 21-frame set was inspected during development; it is not an independent test set.
center_note: Pixel anchors are manually observed head centers, not metrology ground truth.
